prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: exactly one square 2D game UI energy-orb sprite layer, static rear foundation

Consumer contract:
This is Layer 1 of a five-layer 256 by 256 energy counter. It is drawn first, remains static, is uniformly scaled to 128 by 128 in game, and must support four later overlays plus a centered cream energy number. Normal SourceOver compositing is used.

Primary request:
Create exactly one centered magical energy-orb foundation for Vivhite, a mathematically gifted magical girl. Use a deep indigo and midnight-violet faceted circular medallion with a softly luminous blue-violet inner well. The silhouette should be a clean twelve-sided circle, visually stable and substantial, with a calm dark center that keeps cream numerals highly legible.

Geometry and layer responsibility:
One centered, rotationally balanced foundation only. Outer diameter about 78 percent of the square. Preserve a calm circular number-safe zone covering roughly the central 36 percent. Use broad low-frequency shapes and restrained radial depth; this layer must not contain a separate foreground frame, rotating glyph ring, small star lattice, crown, butterfly, particles, or detached sparks. Keep every visible pixel at least 8 percent inside all four edges.

Style and palette:
Polished hand-painted fantasy card-game UI, crisp at 32 and 64 pixels, purple-blue-white-gold Vivhite visual family. Dominant deep indigo and violet, secondary cool blue, only very restrained dim gold pinpoints. Bounded internal luminescence, controlled contrast, no overexposed white mass.

Constraints:
Exactly one coherent centered orb layer. No text, letters, numerals, symbols resembling text, character, face, body, mouth element, weapon, blood, liquid, scenery, panel, sprite sheet, duplicate, watermark, border touching the square, or light field extending to an edge.
